prompts:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: Android adaptive launcher icon foreground layer for Weedtopia.
Edit the supplied selected Weedtopia city icon. Preserve this exact illustrated city, the cafe, greenhouse, tower, cannabis leaf, river island, architecture, colors, lighting and their proportions. Remove only the petrol/teal backdrop and all backdrop glow, make the background genuinely transparent. Produce a clean cutout of the complete illustrated town including river island and large leaf. Place the intact cutout centered on a square transparent canvas and uniformly reduce its scale so the entire cutout fits within the central 62 percent of the canvas width AND height, with at least 19 percent clear transparent padding on all four sides. This generous padding is essential for Android adaptive icon masking; do not enlarge the cutout to fill the image. Preserve exact town geometry and its internal shading, without redesigning it. No text, no frame, no new details, no shadow outside the cutout, no colored background. Deliver one standalone RGBA foreground layer, no mockup.

Edit only the scale and transparent padding of the most recent transparent Weedtopia city cutout. Keep the same cutout and all of its contents intact. On a square canvas, uniformly shrink the entire existing cutout to 75% of its current rendered size, centered exactly. The cutout is currently too large for an Android adaptive icon. Final visible content must fit entirely between x=20% and x=80%, and y=20% and y=80%. Leave a completely transparent border covering at least the outer 20% of all four sides. Do not zoom or crop, do not add or redraw objects, do not restore any colored backdrop. This is a technical icon foreground layer with deliberately generous empty transparent margins.
